title: Ops lateral action finder (one-off tracker)
content:
Purpose: quick, scannable single-sheet to locate the most likely lateral actions (who does what) during the May 2029 regional capacity surge window. Not a formal runbook; this is an ad-hoc triage/todo finder for the first 48 hours.

How to use: open, scan the first 2 columns, assign, update status inline. If you take ownership, change status to 'claimed' and add a short note in the blockers column. We will consolidate into the formal incident doc if this goes >48h.

Summary counts (top-row manual tally):
- Total potential actions: 27
- Unassigned: 9
- Claimed: 10
- Blocked: 3
- Completed: 5

Layout (columns, one row per action):
- ID: short unique id (A1..A27)
- Owner: suggested owner (team or person)
- Quick action: one-sentence task
- Why now: one-line cause/trigger
- Due window: e.g., 0-2h / 2-6h / 6-24h / 24-48h
- Status: unassigned / claimed / in_progress / blocked / done
- Blocker note: short text (if any)
- Quick link: ticket or dashboard link

Sample rows (fill these in first):
A1 | Platform - autoscale | Increase GPU pool for eu-west-1 burst group | demand spike on streaming model X | 0-2h | unassigned | waiting on quota approval | JIRA-OPS-1298
A2 | SRE - routing | Enable fallback-route for hosted-api region eu-west-1 -> us-west-2 | backend throttles observed | 0-2h | claimed | Jordan: coordinating with infra | CONFLUENCE-4821
A3 | Cost - billing | Temporarily apply higher spend cap to dedicated pool (acct 342) | client test run causing rate jump | 2-6h | unassigned | requires finance signoff | billing/342
A4 | Observability | Increase sampling on model-ops traces to spot token stall | elevated tail latency | 2-6h | in_progress | Lina: running sampling job | dashboards/trace-modelX
A5 | SE - customer contact | Notify top 10 affected customers with ETA | support tickets spiking | 6-24h | unassigned | template draft needed | support/alerts-idx

Notes/assumptions:
- This sheet intentionally presumes temporary lateral assignments (someone will 'claim' outside normal rota). Please update owner if you take long-term responsibility.
- Use the Quick link field to point to the canonical artifact (dashboards preferred). If none exists, paste the Slack thread timestamp.
- If you hit a blocker labeled "quota" or "legal", escalate immediately to the escalation matrix (linked artifact above).

Open questions (to capture here so the triage lead can decide):
1) Do we have permission to temporarily raise spend caps for dedicated pools without PO signoff? (finance/PM)
2) Which model variants are allowed as fallback for low-latency routes? (research/serving-runtime)
3) Should we run a short 15-min rolling restart of the eu-west-1 worker set if KV cache thrashing persists? (SRE decision)

Quick rollout checklist if surge persists >24h: (move items to proper runbook)
- Confirm long-term capacity commit for region (platform + finance)
- Schedule canary traffic to fallback region with throttles (serving-runtime + SRE)
- Lock model pinning for critical customers (product + SE)
- Open postmortem stub and appoint PM lead (product-ops)

Change log (small):
- 2029-05-03 Aisha: created sheet, seeded first 5 rows
- 2029-05-05 Jordan: claimed A2, added coordination note
- 2029-05-06 Lina: started trace sampling job (A4)
- 2029-05-08 Aisha: updated summary counts and open questions

Free-form scratch area (notes to self):
- If we can reduce model seq length for non-critical traffic that could buy ~20% headroom; ping research for quick gating criteria.
- Keep an eye on embeddings jobs scheduled at 03:00 UTC — they historically collide with nightly shard compaction.

End of sheet.
